name: Paseah
overview: Paseah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified in Scripture as the son of Eshton. Beyond this genealogical detail, the biblical record does not provide additional information about his life or role. His mention in 1 Chronicles 4:12 situates him within the genealogical lineage important to the people of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Paseah means "hobbling one," reflecting a Hebrew proper name recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:12. There is no indication that this name was given directly by God, and no further titles or meanings are associated with it in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Paseah as the son of Eshton, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented for Paseah beyond this father-son link in 1 Chronicles 4:12.
scriptureSignificance: Paseah's significance lies primarily in his inclusion in the genealogical record of Judah, which underscores the continuity of God's covenant people through successive generations. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal achievements or character, his mention preserves the lineage that ultimately leads to Christ, affirming God's faithfulness in maintaining His chosen family.
